description: Summary figure: YjjI sequence isolation, catalytic geometry, and pocket composition versus characterised GREs
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
sc=pd.read_csv("gre_sw_scores.csv",index_col=0)
geo=pd.read_csv("af_gly_cys_geometry.csv")
poc=pd.read_csv("gre_pocket_composition.csv",index_col=0)

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(16,10))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1.15,1],hspace=0.40,wspace=0.28)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
V=np.array(sc.values,dtype=float,copy=True); np.fill_diagonal(V,np.nan)
im=ax.imshow(np.log10(V+1),cmap="viridis")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(sc)));ax.set_xticklabels(sc.columns,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sc)));ax.set_yticklabels(sc.index,fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("A. Pairwise Smith-Waterman score (log10), BLOSUM62, gap 11/1")
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,fraction=0.046,label="log10(SW score)")
for lab in list(ax.get_yticklabels())+list(ax.get_xticklabels()):
    if lab.get_text()=="YjjI_ECOLI": lab.set_color("crimson"); lab.set_fontweight("bold")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
refs=[c for c in sc.columns if c not in ("YjjI_ECOLI","NrdD_ECOLI")]
within=sc.loc[refs,refs].values[np.triu_indices(len(refs),1)]
nr=sc.loc["NrdD_ECOLI",refs].values.astype(float)
yj=sc.loc["YjjI_ECOLI",refs].values.astype(float)
ax.boxplot([within,nr,yj],tick_labels=["between the 11\nPFL-like GREs","NrdD (class III RNR)\nvs PFL-like GREs","YjjI\nvs PFL-like GREs"],widths=0.5)
for i,(v,c) in enumerate(zip([within,nr,yj],["#4C78A8","#72B7B2","crimson"]),start=1):
    ax.scatter(rng.normal(i,0.06,len(v)),v,s=18,alpha=0.65,color=c,zorder=3)
ax.set_yscale("log");ax.set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman raw score")
ax.set_title("B. YjjI pairwise similarity to characterised GREs is at background level")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
g=geo.sort_values("dist_GlyCA_CysSG")
cols=["crimson" if p=="YjjI_ECOLI" else "#4C78A8" for p in g.protein]
ax.barh(g.protein,g.dist_GlyCA_CysSG,color=cols)
for i,d in enumerate(g.dist_GlyCA_CysSG): ax.text(d+0.06,i,f"{d:.2f}",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("distance, radical Gly CA to nearest Cys SG (angstrom), AlphaFold v6")
ax.set_title("C. YjjI Gly465 lies 3.78 A from Cys236, as in every characterised GRE")
ax.set_xlim(0,6.6)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
cats=['pos','neg','polar','arom','apol']
P=poc[cats].astype(float)
P=P.loc[["YjjI_ECOLI"]+[i for i in P.index if i!="YjjI_ECOLI"]]
bottom=np.zeros(len(P)); colors=dict(pos="#4C78A8",neg="#E45756",polar="#72B7B2",arom="#B279A2",apol="#F2B701")
for c in cats:
    ax.bar(range(len(P)),P[c].values,bottom=bottom,label=c,color=colors[c]); bottom+=P[c].values
ax.set_xticks(range(len(P)));ax.set_xticklabels(P.index,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax.get_xticklabels()[0].set_color("crimson");ax.get_xticklabels()[0].set_fontweight("bold")
ax.set_ylabel("% of pocket residues");ax.legend(fontsize=8,ncol=5,loc="lower center",bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,1.03))
ax.set_title("D. Pocket composition, residues within 10 A of the catalytic Cys SG",pad=30)
plt.show()

print("Catalytic Cys context (Cys is residue 6 of the 11-mer); Glu at Cys+2 is the general base of the\neliminase and decarboxylase GREs:")
print(poc[['cys_ctx','Cys_plus1','Cys_plus2']].to_string())
print("\nYjjI pocket basic residues:", "R70, R251, R392, R462(Gly-loop Arg), H159, H215, H376")
